title: armeria arctica subsp. californica
intro: Armeria arctica subsp. californica, commonly known as the California Sea Thrift, is a flowering plant species within the Plumbaginaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its ability to support the immune system and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, making it beneficial for health. The therapeutic actions of Armeria arctica subsp. californica include its use as an anti-inflammatory and antiseptic agent, which can aid in wound healing and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
